title: depshieldx report
description: Top-level shape of the report depshieldx install/scan write to stdout with --output json. Validates the stable contract only (top-level keys and their types) -- nested provenance/scan/sandbox internals are intentionally not exhaustively validated here, since those are expected to evolve as CVE sources and sandboxing change. Unknown top-level fields are allowed so the contract can grow without breaking consumers.

schema_version.description: Bumped whenever a breaking change is made to this report shape.

ecosystem.description: Which package-manager ecosystem this report is for, e.g. "pypi".

receipt.description: Present once _prepare_report_with_receipt has run (always true for the final report printed to the user).
